look.outfit_lock: blue-violet skin, peacock-feather crown, layered pearl-and-emerald necklaces, cream silk uttariya, gold armlets

presence.gaze: eyes fixed just past the other person, never into the lens, never darting to them for approval; blink rate low
presence.mouth: jaw closed and at rest between phrases; when speaking, the mouth opens minimally and returns fully closed
presence.hands: hands low and still, out of frame unless the beat requires an object; never raised to explain
presence.head: head level and heavy; no tilt toward camera, no nod on the other person's lines
presence.timing: reacts one full beat after the other person finishes, never on the same beat
presence.weight: settled before the shot begins, never shifts while speaking, does not lean in
presence.breath: breath visible as slow, low movement in the shoulders and necklace; nothing else moves with it
